name: apex-fresh-set-2
frozen: 2026-11-28, committed before any false-positive rule was implemented (docs/architecture/apex-first-capability.md §11.2). Set 1's remaining false positives were known; the rule ideas below were known to the author in outline.
status: SELF-AUTHORED development data. Written by the same author who will write the false-positive rules, after classifying set 1's nine remaining false positives and with the candidate rules in mind. Several vulnerable cases are deliberately built to probe a rule's failure mode (marked `probes`). It measures the mechanism on contracts written before the rules; it is not a benchmark, not a frozen eval corpus, and not evidence of detection quality on real code.
wellFormedness: Before freezing, each contract was only parsed and deployed. The candidate ids each contract can generate were listed from the deployed engine's static candidate set (Engine.checks and the precommitted partition shapes), without running any search, so that every id is labelled before any verdict exists. No search was run, and no verdict, violation or hypothesis was looked at.

scoring.run: exploreStateInvariants(sources, contract, options) with each version's default options unless stated; the options used are recorded with every measurement.
scoring.detection: A vulnerable case is DETECTED when at least one reported violation (equivalently, hypothesis) has breakingFunction in accept.breakers AND the family of its candidate id (the text before the first ':') in accept.families.
scoring.wrongClaim: Any other violation on a vulnerable case is a WRONG CLAIM and counts as a false positive.
scoring.secureTwin: Every violation on a secure twin is a false positive.
scoring.control: Every violation on a control is a false positive.
scoring.reclassified: A counterexample that the explorer reclassifies (for example as privileged behaviour or as a designed cycle) and does NOT report as a violation or hypothesis counts neither as a detection nor as a false positive. Reclassified counterexamples are listed with every measurement.
scoring.falseInvariantRate: On the controls only: falseAccepted / (falseAccepted + trueAccepted), over candidates whose id is labelled in controls[].truth. Unlabelled candidate ids are listed and excluded. Labels are not changed after the freeze; a label added later goes in a separate file marked post-freeze.
scoring.cost: Total interpreter transitions per run are reported for every measurement.

candidateIdGrammar.conservation:A=sum(L): scalar A equals the sum of ledger L
candidateIdGrammar.actor-value:attacker-net<=0: the observed actor never receives more ether than it sent
candidateIdGrammar.one-way:V: V never returns toward its deployed value except by the deployer
candidateIdGrammar.backing:balance>=A: ether held covers scalar A (not generated today; labelled so it cannot be fitted later)
candidateIdGrammar.partition:A+B=sum(L): two scalars, in alphabetical order, together equal the sum of ledger L
candidateIdGrammar.partition:A=sum(L)+sum(M): scalar A equals the sum of two ledgers, in alphabetical order

vulnerable.category: accounting drift behind a privileged switch
vulnerable.needs: the owner's start() on the path (privileged, no ether); then exit: 3 transactions for the accounting break, 5 for a theft of another depositor's ether
vulnerable.bug: exit pays the caller's balance and reduces totalDeposits but never zeroes the balance, so it can be exited again with other depositors' ether
vulnerable.probes: a privileged step on the attack path that funds nothing: a rule must not treat 'a privileged step is on the path' as 'privileged behaviour'

vulnerable.needs: the owner funds the pool (privileged, with ether); a depositor claims the bonus more than once; 4+ transactions
vulnerable.bug: claim checks the claimed flag but never sets it, so one depositor can drain the bonus pool funded for every depositor
vulnerable.probes: the attacker's gain is bounded by ether the owner paid in through a privileged function, exactly as for a designed bonus; no inferred family separates one claim from many, so the twin's designed bonus is expected to look the same. Included to measure the recall cost of a privileged-funding rule.

vulnerable.category: accounting drift next to privileged credits
vulnerable.bug: withdrawAll pays out and zeroes the balance but never adds to totalWithdrawn (withdraw does)
vulnerable.probes: totalDeposited = sum(balances) + totalWithdrawn holds except across the owner's credit() and the buggy withdrawAll: a refinement that excuses privileged transitions must still not excuse the unprivileged one

vulnerable.bug: anyone may abort an unfinished epoch, resetting the stage (the design reserves abort for the owner); finish is the designed reset at the end of an epoch
vulnerable.probes: a reset that also advances a counter, as a designed cycle does, but from the middle of the cycle

vulnerable.needs: 4 transactions: vote, vote, pass, newRound (a 5th, pass, shows the impact)
vulnerable.bug: newRound reopens voting without clearing the tally, so the next round passes with no votes
vulnerable.probes: a reset at the end of the cycle that does NOT restore the round's initial state; the one-way family flags the reset itself, in the twin too

vulnerable.category: share accounting under a share price above 1
vulnerable.needs: 3 transactions: deposit, the owner's harvest (privileged, with ether), redeem
vulnerable.bug: redeem reduces totalShares by the asset amount instead of the share amount
vulnerable.probes: share-vs-asset relations and privileged yield next to a same-unit conservation bug: rules that drop totalAssets=sum(shares) or owner-funded yield must keep totalShares=sum(shares)

vulnerable.needs: 2 transactions: stake, unstake of the whole stake (a state-derived amount)
vulnerable.bug: the full-exit branch zeroes the stake but never reduces totalStaked
vulnerable.probes: the same candidate is also broken, by design, by the owner's privileged rebase: a rule that reclassifies privileged breakers must still report the unprivileged one

secureNote: Each twin differs from its vulnerable case only in the fix. Every violation on a twin is a false positive. Twins S02 (designed bonus), S05 (designed reset), S06 (owner-funded yield) and S07 (owner-funded rebase) are correct but asymmetric by design.

controls.design: the owner funds a budget and allots it to any address; recipients collect what they are owed

conservation:budget=sum(owed).why: allot moves value from budget to owed; fund raises budget alone; collect lowers owed alone

actor-value:attacker-net<=0.why: the owner may allot to any address, which collects ether it never sent: designed and privileged

partition:budget+totalCollected=sum(owed.why: not a relation of the design

backing:balance>=totalCollected.why: collected ether has left the contract

controls.design: a unit vault; the owner adds yield once units exist; joins and exits round down

conservation:managed=sum(units).why: managed exceeds units once yield is added (different units)

solvency:balance>=sum(units).why: balance = managed >= totalUnits (the price never falls below 1)

actor-value:attacker-net<=0.why: holders earn the owner's yield by design

partition:managed+totalUnits=sum(units).why: not a relation of the design

controls.design: anyone advances the phase to 2 and may then wrap it to 0, clearing the marks and counting the cycle

one-way:phase.why: the phase wraps to 0 by design, by anyone, at the end of a cycle

one-way:marks.why: marks are cleared on wrap by design

controls.design: anyone ticks the lap to 3 and may then clear it, restoring the deployed state exactly

one-way:lap.why: the lap is cleared to 0 by design, by anyone, at the end of a lap

controls.design: a share vault seeded with at least 1 ether; anyone may donate to the holders, at most doubling the share price per donation; rounding favours the vault

conservation:totalAssets=sum(shares).why: assets exceed shares once anything is donated (different units)

solvency:balance>=sum(shares).why: balance = totalAssets >= totalShares (the price never falls below 1)

actor-value:attacker-net<=0.why: holders receive donations and rounding remainders by design

partition:totalAssets+totalShares=sum(sh.why: not a relation of the design

controls.fpKind: cumulative counters next to a privileged grant
controls.design: members join and leave (cumulative totalJoined and totalLeft); the owner grants a fixed bonus from a funded pool to any address

conservation:totalJoined=sum(credit).why: bonuses and leaves change credit without totalJoined

actor-value:attacker-net<=0.why: the owner may grant a bonus to any address, which then leaves with ether it never sent: designed and privileged

partition:bonusPool+totalJoined=sum(cred.why: not a relation of the design

partition:bonusPool+totalLeft=sum(credit.why: not a relation of the design

partition:totalJoined+totalLeft=sum(cred.why: not a relation of the design

backing:balance>=totalJoined.why: leaves lower the balance but not totalJoined

backing:balance>=totalLeft.why: left ether has left the contract

relationToSet1: The controls are of the five kinds behind set 1's remaining false positives: privileged action (Rebate), designed yield (YieldShares, S08), cyclic reset (Seasons), share-vs-asset units (totalAssets=sum(shares) on V03, V08, S08, YieldShares), and cumulative counters (Rebate's totalDeposited).
